categories.main_business_segments: Fujian Cosunter Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in pharmaceutical manufacturing, focusing on antiviral drugs, liver health medications, cardiovascular drugs, and male health products. The company has a strong presence in generic drugs, especially nucleos(t)ide analog antiviral drugs for hepatitis B, and is actively developing innovative drugs including treatments for COVID-19, hepatitis B clinical cure, liver cancer, and liver fibrosis. It also engages in pharmaceutical research, production, and sales, with subsidiaries involved in drug formulation and biotechnological research.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies including nucleos(t)ide analog synthesis and formulation, with GMP-compliant production processes. It employs innovative drug development methods such as multi-target antiviral mechanisms, clinical trial phases I to III for new drugs, and capitalizes on patented drug formulations and delivery technologies. The company also integrates research and development with production, including proprietary drug discovery and clinical trial management, and uses specialized manufacturing techniques like Tab-in-Tab for compound drugs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals, retail pharmacies, and government procurement agencies across China. The company serves patients with hepatitis B, liver diseases, cardiovascular conditions, male health issues, and COVID-19. Its major markets are domestic Chinese provinces with a nationwide sales network, focusing on public hospitals, retail drugstores, and centralized government drug procurement programs. The company also collaborates with large pharmaceutical groups and healthcare institutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, covering major regions including North, East, South, Northwest, and Southwest China. It has production bases and subsidiaries in Fujian, Jiangsu, and other provinces, with sales and marketing networks spanning provincial capitals, cities, and counties nationwide. There is no significant overseas operation reported, but the company is exploring international cooperation for innovative drug development.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fujian Cosunter Pharmaceutical operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, encompassing drug research and development, manufacturing of active pharmaceutical ingredients and finished dosage forms, and distribution through direct sales, agency sales, and government procurement channels. It also engages in upstream activities such as raw material synthesis for key antiviral drugs but primarily focuses on production and commercialization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven growth, emphasizing the development of innovative drugs for hepatitis B clinical cure, liver cancer, liver fibrosis, and COVID-19 treatment. It pursues a combined approach of generic and innovative drug development, with significant R&D investment in clinical trials and global patent protection. The company aims to enhance its product pipeline through internal R&D, partnerships, and acquisitions, while also expanding into traditional Chinese medicine and international markets. Strengthening marketing, operational efficiency, and capital management are also key priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pharmaceutical products including generic and innovative drugs. The company employs multiple sales models: direct sales to hospitals and pharmacies, agency sales through distributors, and participation in national centralized drug procurement programs. Additional income sources include government subsidies related to innovation drug development and rental income from leasing properties. Licensing or subscription models are not prominently reported.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic pharmaceutical enterprise specializing in antiviral and liver health drugs, holding a competitive edge with five major nucleos(t)ide analog antiviral drugs approved and included in national medical insurance catalogs. It competes with other Chinese pharmaceutical firms in antiviral and liver disease treatment markets, leveraging its innovation capabilities and comprehensive product portfolio. Its innovative COVID-19 drug approval marks a significant milestone, enhancing its industry standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 441 million, representing a 4.43% increase over the previous year. Despite ongoing net losses due to high R&D investment and market pressures, the net loss narrowed by 55.16% year-over-year. The company’s total assets were about RMB 1.44 billion with a decrease of 10.88% from the prior year-end. Cash flow from operating activities turned positive, indicating improved operational quality. The company continues to invest heavily in innovation while managing financial risks.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fujian Cosunter Pharmaceutical emphasizes its unique value proposition in providing high-quality, cost-effective antiviral and liver health medications with strong clinical efficacy and safety profiles. Its differentiation lies in owning a comprehensive portfolio of nucleos(t)ide analog drugs for hepatitis B, all passing consistency evaluations, and pioneering innovative drugs with novel mechanisms targeting clinical cure of hepatitis B and COVID-19 treatment. The company also highlights its integrated R&D-to-commercialization capabilities, extensive nationwide sales network, and commitment to innovation and quality control as key competitive advantages.
